faqs.q: Can cold email and LinkedIn really reach Plant Heads and VP Manufacturing?
faqs.a: Yes. Senior manufacturing and automation leaders actively monitor work email and LinkedIn, especially when approached concisely around a real throughput, quality, or line-expansion problem.

faqs.q: Can you help a Pune automation company diversify beyond automotive into pharma or FMCG?
faqs.a: Yes. Building new-vertical lists is one of the highest-ROI uses of managed outbound. We map pharma, food processing, packaging, and EV plants across India and tailor proof points to each sector.

faqs.q: Can you also generate export RFQs from Europe or the US?
faqs.a: Yes. We have booked verified RFQ and sample meetings in Germany, France, the US, and the UAE for Indian industrial and engineering firms.

faqs.q: How do you make sure leads match our project ticket size?
faqs.a: We filter target companies by plant count, employee band, revenue tier, and industry before outreach, and qualify project scope during reply handling.

faqs.q: How soon can our engineering sales team expect discovery meetings?
faqs.a: Setup, domain warming, and verified list building take 2 weeks. Initial technical conversations and RFQ discussions typically start in weeks 3 to 5.
